mapper.select: SELECT detail_id, record_id, user_id, question_id, answer_type, submitted_answer, is_correct, blank_index, created_at FROM COL_USER_ANSWER_DETAIL WHERE detail_id = #{detailId}

SELECT d.record_id AS recordId, d.user_id AS userId, d.question_id AS questionId, d.answer_type AS answerType, d.submitted_answer AS submittedAnswer, q.col_content AS correctAnswer, r.answer_evaluation AS answerEvaluation, d.detail_id AS detailId FROM COL_USER_ANSWER_DETAIL d JOIN COL_QUESTION q ON d.question_id = q.col_id JOIN COL_USER_ANSWER_RECORD r ON d.record_id = r.record_id WHERE d.record_id = #{recordId} AND d.user_id = #{userId}

SELECT detail_id AS detailId, record_id AS recordId, user_id AS userId, question_id AS questionId, answer_type AS answerType, submitted_answer AS submittedAnswer, is_correct AS isCorrect, blank_index AS blankIndex, created_at AS createdAt FROM COL_USER_ANSWER_DETAIL WHERE record_id = #{recordId}

SELECT DISTINCT user.detail_id AS detailId, user.record_id AS recordId, user.user_id AS userId, user.question_id AS questionId, user.answer_type AS answerType, user.submitted_answer AS submittedAnswer, user.is_correct AS isCorrect, user.blank_index AS blankIndex, user.created_at AS createdAt, COALESCE( (SELECT COL_PLACEHOLDER_FORMAT FROM COL_QUESTION WHERE col_id = user.question_id AND COL_TYPE = 'FILL_IN_THE_BLANK' LIMIT 1), (SELECT COL_MATCHING_KEY FROM col_answer WHERE COL_QUESTION_ID = user.question_id AND COL_IS_CORRECT = TRUE LIMIT 1) ) AS mergedColumn FROM COL_USER_ANSWER_DETAIL user WHERE record_id = #{recordId}
